savedFailuresExplained.cause: The helper call(path:string,...) has no default. The test calls f.call() without a path, producing /api/v1/projects/p/supervisorundefined. Its nonmatching-route JSON has no data, so reading value.data.session throws. This occurs after the test already asserted that the private adoption request returned 400.
savedFailuresExplained.narrowFix: Default path to the empty string or call f.call('') explicitly, and assert the GET HTTP status/envelope before reading session. Preserve the original failed logs. Do not weaken the application privacy guard to repair this test.
savedFailuresExplained.limit: The failure does not prove the app accepted private content, nor does identifying this fixture defect establish complete privacy acceptance. The subsequent guard assertions were not reached.

savedFailuresExplained.case: adoption expected one dispatch but observed zero
savedFailuresExplained.cause: The replacement model is async()=>({}), which has no valid action or directive. In the final R5 source the first pump only records adopt-source-verified and returns; after reconcile, the next pump consumes the source through the normal evidence/model path. It then receives {}, persists that replacement-model result and rejects its missing action. No valid continue decision exists that could authorize the expected dispatch.
savedFailuresExplained.narrowFix: Supply a valid bounded continue decision for the successful adoption test and separately assert the first source-verification phase, model input/decision and dispatch. Keep an invalid-decision case as its own failure-boundary case. Do not bypass model judgment or change the expected count merely to obtain green output.
savedFailuresExplained.timingCorrection: An initial reviewer message assumed the first pump already called the model. Reading final R5 line 66 corrected that assumption: the dedicated adopt-source-verified branch returns before ordinary consumption/model processing. This report records the corrected final-source order.
savedFailuresExplained.limit: This saved assertion alone cannot establish that a real valid-model first adoption dispatch is broken. The stale adoption binding and consumed-result reconcile defects below are independently established by source dataflow.

savedFailuresExplained.cause: The old replacement execution map still puts agentVersion:'v1' on the run and supplies a result without executionMetadata. R5 now matches nativeCliVersion from result.executionMetadata, so the current binding version is null and the pre-seeded v1 candidate is correctly excluded.
savedFailuresExplained.narrowFix: Update this fixture to the new signed metadata contract and add a DTO/runtime-path assertion proving actual metadata propagation; retain missing-version rejection. Do not relax the exact version selector or infer version from the fixture-only agentVersion property.

remainingP1.title: The first adopted handoff never consumes its adoption binding, so the next continuation reuses the old run/version
remainingP1.trigger: A valid adopted source receives a valid continue decision, its first new CC run actually completes, and the supervisor attempts another continuation.
remainingP1.evidence: Each dispatch chooses expectedTaskRevision, consumedRunId and resultHash from s.adoptionBinding before the latest task/session fields. After a successful dispatch it changes runId and deletes intent/grant fields but never consumes/removes/advances adoptionBinding. The later outcome updates consumedRunId/resultHash, yet the next dispatch still sends the original adopted task revision and r-old. Actual executionRuntime rejects the stale task revision/current executionRequest.
remainingP1.narrowFix: Use the adoption proof only for the first successful supervised handoff. After its durable receipt, preserve the adoption history in immutable evidence while subsequent dispatches use the latest consumed supervised run/hash/current task revision. Make crash/replay of that transition idempotent.
remainingP1.requiredFocusedEvidence: An authorized finite real-runtime fixture must exercise adoption plus two successive supervised handoffs and restart/replay at the first handoff; a replacement executor that never advances task revision is insufficient. Not executed here.

remainingP1.title: Reconcile reports running for an already consumed source without restoring a reachable judgment state
remainingP1.trigger: A source has already been inserted into supervisor_consumed, but its model judgment failed, was interrupted or was rejected; the owner invokes the new reconcile route.
remainingP1.evidence: reconcile unconditionally sets enabled=true/status=running after terminal/source checks. It does not account for the existing modelIntentId, consumed row or uncertain/completed model state. advance only processes that intent when status=judging; under status=running it returns immediately when the consumed row exists. The route can therefore return success while its next pump makes no progress.
remainingP1.narrowFix: Reconcile according to the durable phase: resume a previously complete valid judgment in judging state, preserve started/uncertain calls as explicit reconciliation-required without silently re-calling, or reject an unsupported resolution. Never report running when its only source is already consumed and no actionable phase is selected. Keep original observations/accounting.
remainingP1.requiredFocusedEvidence: Separate unconsumed adopted-source verification from consumed/complete, consumed/invalid and started/uncertain model cases. Assert actual state transition and absence of duplicate model/CC effects, not just HTTP 200. Not executed here.

remainingP1.title: Pi system prompt and response validator still disagree on experienceReferences
remainingP1.evidence: R5 leaves the actual Pi system override at exactly five keys, while runtime always supplies experienceReferences and the adapter requires the sixth key. Both pi.ts and project-supervisor-model.ts have the same fingerprints as R4.
remainingP1.narrowFix: Use one same-source response contract for the actual system prompt and strict parser, explicitly covering empty/nonempty references. Do not rely on a contradictory lower-priority Also return instruction or a replacement-model HTTP fixture.
remainingP1.requiredFocusedEvidence: An actual prompt/adapter contract check plus the next required genuine supervisor judgment, separately identifying provider usage and accepted strict output. No provider call was made by this reviewer.
